book.name: 2 Corinth
book.title: Paul Secon Letta Ta Dem Een Corinth

content: So A mek op me mind dat A ain gwine come gin an tell oona ting wa gwine mek oona haat sad.
Ef A beena mek oona haat sad, who dat gwine be lef fa mek me heppy? Ain nobody bot dem dat A mek sad, ainty?

Dat hoccome A done write oona dat letta. A ain been wahn fa come an hab me haat sad. De same people wa oughta mek me rejaice done mek me sad. Cause A know fa sho dat wen A rejaice, oona gwine rejaice too.
Wen A beena write ta oona, me haat been hebby an A beena warry bad. A beena cry plenty. Bot A ain write ta oona fa mek oona haat sad. A been write fa mek oona know hommuch A lob oona.
Oona Oughta Paadon de One wa Done Bad
Now den, somebody done do a bad ting wa been mek people sad. Ain me e done mek sad. Bot A know, e mek all ob oona sad a leetle bit. A ain wahn fa mek dat one feel bad tommuch.
Mos ob oona done punish dat one yah, so leh dat do.
So den, oona oughta paadon um now an courage um so dat e ain gwine git so sad dat e ain able fa go on.
Please leh um know dat oona lob um.
A done write oona dat letta cause A been wahn fa test oona an see ef oona ready all de time fa do wa A tell oona fa do.
Wen oona paadon somebody fa wa e done bad, A gwine paadon dat one too. An ef dey some reason fa me fa paadon sompin, A gwine paadon um fo Christ fa sake ob oona.
A do dat so dat Satan ain gwine be able fa win out oba we een nottin. Cause we know e da scheme fa mek op bad ting fa do ginst we.
Paul Beena Warry een Troas
Wen A got ta Troas fa tell um de Good Nyews bout Christ, A see dat de Lawd mek a way fa me fa wok dey.
Bot een me haat A beena warry bad, cause A ain find me broda Titus dey. So A tell de people dey say, A da gwine, an A gone on ta Macedonia.
Een Christ We Win

We tell God tankya, cause God mek Christ win out oba de powa ob ebil. An wen we one wid Christ, God all de time da mek we hab we paat wid Christ fa win out oba de powa ob ebil. An God da nyuse we fa spread all oba, wa people oughta know bout Christ, like a sweet smell kin spread all oba.
We jes like de sweet smell wa da come fom incense, wa Christ da gii ta God. Dem people wa God da sabe an dem wa da gwine pon dey way fa be loss faeba, dey all da smell um.
Fa dem wa da gwine ta hell, dat a smell wa da kill. Bot fa dem wa gwine git sabe, dat a smell wa da gii life. Ain nobody fit fa do dis wok ainty?
Cause we ain like plenty people wa da tell oda people God wod fa mek money. Bot cause God sen we, we wa da saab Christ, we da taak scraight wod fo God.
